answer_1.quote: To analyze hallucinations in LVLMs when faced with multi-turn visual and textual inputs, we introduce VisDiaHalBench, a novel visual dialogue benchmark... We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of several state-of-the-art LVLMs... The dataset includes five-turn dialogues where models generate textual answers.
answer_1.outputs: textual answers in multi-turn visual dialogue

answer_2.quote: we reported macroaverage F1 in the word level and Exact Match (EM) to estimate the performance of answer extraction after extracting the model's output results through keyword filtering.

answer_4.quote: We ask two human annotators to answer the questions for 50 sampled dialogues with a total of 250 questions... Human-labeled answers achieve a 95.29% accuracy compared to the groundtruth answers... We also randomly select 50 images and ask two annotators to rate an edited image... The agreement ratio represents the extent to which the rating provided by the two annotators matches.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to answer each question (or rate edited images) and their responses were compared to ground-truth; accuracy, exact match, and F1 scores were computed.
